glosses: museum (a building or institution dedicated to the acquisition, conservation, study, exhibition, and educational interpretation of objects having scientific, historical, cultural or artistic value)

examples.en: We can go to the museum.
The museum is worth a visit.

examples.text: Tu as visité combien de musées ?
examples.en: How many museums did you visit?

examples.text: Veux-tu venir avec nous au musée ?
examples.en: Do you want to come to the museum with us?
